title: bench env: dev DB default-tenant schema provisioning fails (tenant_schemas.migrations_applied_at NULL) blocks WF-04
summary: The dev/bench DB (`BPM_DB_URL` -> postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5442/bpm_dev) cannot complete default-tenant schema provisioning: `provisionTenantSchema()` for the default tenant (00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000) returns `error.MigrationFailed`, so `public.tenant_schemas.migrations_applied_at` stays NULL. The ISS-0706/GH-791 leg-(d) post-condition added to `src/tools/migrate.zig` then hard-exits `zig build migrate`, which also blocks `zig build bench` (the WF-04 full NFR benchmark procedure). Not VLD-attributable: the branch diff has no migration files and the test DB (5434/bpm_test) migrate passes 147/147. Severity MAJOR — environmental, dev/bench DB only; does not block the VLD-01/02/03 release.
scope: Environment defect on the dev/bench database (BPM_DB_URL, postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5442/bpm_dev). Default-tenant (`tenant_default` for tenant 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000) schema provisioning fails, leaving `public.tenant_schemas.migrations_applied_at` NULL and causing the ISS-0706 leg-(d) post-condition in `src/tools/migrate.zig` to abort `zig build migrate` / `zig build bench`. Affects ONLY the bench path (WF-04 full NFR run). CI / test-DB path unaffected (migrate 147/147 on 5434/bpm_test).
description: During WF03-vld-impl-bugs-20260816 step-6 (RELEASE-VALIDATOR, 2026-08-16T08:17:28Z), the NFR benchmark prerequisite was found to fail against the dev/bench DB. `zig build bench` (WF-04 full NFR metric suite) cannot start: its migrate precondition fails against BPM_DB_URL (postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5442/bpm_dev) with `default tenant schema provisioning failed: error.MigrationFailed (tenant_id=00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000)` followed by `post-condition: default tenant_schemas.migrations_applied_at is NULL after provisionTenantSchema() returned -- aborting migrate`. The same failure reproduces with a plain `zig build migrate` against the dev DB. The failure is emitted by the ISS-0706/GH-791 leg-(d) post-condition check in `src/tools/migrate.zig` (the fix that made bench provisioning failures loud instead of silently swallowed). The post-condition firing proves `provisionTenantSchema()` genuinely fails on the dev DB (it returned `error.MigrationFailed` from the `runForSchema` migration pass for the default tenant), which is a distinct, deeper defect from the fresh-DB pre-flight gate that GH-791 fixed. Not VLD-attributable: the WF03-vld-impl-bugs-20260816 branch diff contains no migration files, and `test-env-verify` C3 confirms the test DB (5434/bpm_test) migrate passes 147/147. No NFR_RESULT metrics were emitted, so no NFR threshold failed; the block is on the WF-04 benchmark procedure only.
symptom: zig build bench (and plain zig build migrate) against the dev/bench DB BPM_DB_URL (postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5442/bpm_dev) hard-exits 1 during the default-tenant provisioning step with `default tenant schema provisioning failed: error.MigrationFailed (tenant_id=00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000)` and `post-condition: default tenant_schemas.migrations_applied_at is NULL after provisionTenantSchema() returned -- aborting migrate`. The WF-04 full NFR benchmark cannot start.

(2) ISS-0604 (RESOLVED) and ISS-0605 (RESOLVED) cover fresh-DB bootstrap circular-dependency and tenant-registry/schema consistency respectively — different root causes, both resolved. (3) `gh issue list --search 'bench in:title'` returns only GH-791 (closed) and GH-732 (NFR-04 benchmark fidelity, unrelated). (4) No GitHub issue references 'ISS-0714'; GitHub issue #714 is an unrelated closed lint issue (different numbering sequence, no collision per prior-run convention). New issue. resolution.summary: dev-DB ledger reconciliation executed; zig build migrate + zig build bench (WF-04 full NFR) green, all GH #809 ACs met.
resolution.root_cause: STATE MISMATCH on the dev/bench DB (BPM_DB_URL -> postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5442/bpm_dev): tenant_default was already provisioned with the modern table shape (events PARTITIONED BY RANGE (created_at) from 1147_par01) yet public.schema_migrations had ZERO rows for schema_name=tenant_default and public.tenant_schemas.migrations_applied_at was NULL, so provisionTenantSchema() re-applied the full migration set from scratch and 001_event_store.sql CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_event_idempotency failed with SQLSTATE 42P16 (unique constraint on partitioned table must include all partitioning columns) -- runForSchema -> MigrationFailed -> migrate.zig leg-(d) post-condition abort.
resolution.fix: dev-DB-only reconciliation -- NO src/*.zig or migrations/*.sql change. Reconcile public.schema_migrations for schema_name=tenant_default to the canonical 111 rows (test-DB 5434 ground truth + 98-file completeness guard from the current migrations/ dir; 209 statements / 111 unique versions, INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING in one BEGIN/COMMIT with ON_ERROR_STOP=1) and stamp public.tenant_schemas.migrations_applied_at = NOW() for the default tenant. After repair: zig build migrate against 5442 exits 0 with provisioning fast-pathing and the leg-(d) post-condition passing (public backlog GBL-116..143 + 1134..1162 = 59 applied); zig build bench (WF-04 full NFR) runs to completion exit 0 with NFR_BENCH_SUMMARY overall_passed=true; no test-DB regression (5434/bpm_test still 147/147 public + 111 tenant_default).

root_cause_analysis.method: Reproduced `zig build migrate` against BPM_DB_URL (postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5442/bpm_dev): CLI shows only `default tenant schema provisioning failed: error.MigrationFailed (tenant_id=00000000-...)` then the ISS-0706 leg-(d) post-condition abort (exit 1). The underlying SQL error is SWALLOWED by runForSchema() in src/db/migrations.zig (conn.simpleQuery catch -> ROLLBACK -> return MigrationError.MigrationFailed, no per-migration logging) and src/tools/migrate.zig logs only the error enum name. Surfaced the real error from the Postgres SERVER log (docker logs r-co-db-1; log_min_error_statement=error default): `ERROR: unique constraint on partitioned table must include all partitioning columns / DETAIL: UNIQUE constraint on table "events" lacks column "created_at" which is part of the partition key.` STATEMENT: -- 001_event_store.sql (the whole migration file is logged as one simple-query statement). Identical error at 10:44:00 UTC (prior bench attempt) and 10:54:19 UTC (this reproduce) — reproducible.
root_cause_analysis.failing_statement: 001_event_store.sql line 48: `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_event_idempotency ON events(idempotency_key);` — the FIRST unique index on `events` in 001 (line 52 uq_event_sequence would fail identically).
root_cause_analysis.sql_error: ERROR: unique constraint on partitioned table must include all partitioning columns | DETAIL: UNIQUE constraint on table "events" lacks column "created_at" which is part of the partition key. | SQLSTATE 42P16 (invalid_table_definition).
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: STATE MISMATCH on the dev DB. `tenant_default` schema is ALREADY provisioned with the MODERN table shape (events is PARTITIONED by RANGE (created_at) from 1147_par01_events_partitioning.sql; effects_outbox, plat_effect_completion, plat_partition_catalog, instance_projections token-model columns, events_2026_08/09/10 partitions, etc. are all present — 58 tables) YET public.schema_migrations has ZERO rows for schema_name='tenant_default' (empty tenant migration ledger; no tenant_* schema_name rows at all) and public.tenant_schemas.migrations_applied_at is NULL for the default tenant (row created 2026-08-15T05:45Z, never stamped). Because the ledger is empty and migrations_applied_at is NULL, provisionTenantSchema() cannot take its Step-2 idempotency fast-path, so runForSchema('tenant_default') re-applies the ENTIRE non-public-only migration set from scratch (001 onward) against the already-provisioned schema. 001's CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ... uq_event_idempotency ON events(idempotency_key) runs against the already-PARTITIONED events table; PostgreSQL rejects any UNIQUE index that omits the partition key created_at -> SQLSTATE 42P16. runForSchema -> MigrationFailed -> provisionTenantSchema -> ProvisionError.MigrationFailed -> migrate.zig leg-(d) post-condition abort (the exact observed symptom).
root_cause_analysis.state_mismatch_or_defect: STATE MISMATCH (environment / dev-DB-specific) — NOT a migration-set defect. The healthy TEST DB (postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5434/bpm_test) has the SAME partitioned events shape (RANGE (created_at)) and migrates 147/147 public + 111 tenant_default with tenant_schemas.migrations_applied_at IS NOT NULL. On a fresh schema 001's unique indexes are created against a REGULAR events table (1147 converts it to partitioned only later, and handles the index rebuild), so the migration set is proven correct. The defect is purely the dev DB's empty tenant_default ledger + NULL migrations_applied_at coexisting with an already-provisioned modern schema.

test_db_evidence.tenant_schemas_row: tenant_default, migrations_applied_at IS NOT NULL = true

root_cause_analysis.fix_approach: Repair the dev DB ledger + registry ONLY — NO migration-set change and NO src/*.zig change required. (a) Populate public.schema_migrations for schema_name='tenant_default' with the 111 non-public-only/non-tenant_only migrations of the current set (canonical reference = the healthy test DB's tenant_default ledger, which exactly matches the current migrations/ dir; derive via migrationScope over the on-disk set if preferred). (b) SET public.tenant_schemas.migrations_applied_at = NOW() for the default tenant. (c) Spot-check that reconciled ledger versions correspond to objects actually present in tenant_default (verified: modern shape present). After repair, `zig build migrate` on 5442 fast-paths provisioning (Step-2 idempotency now passes), the leg-(d) post-condition passes, then the public pass applies the pending GBL-116..143 + 1134..1162 backlog; exit 0 and `zig build bench` proceeds. IMPORTANT: simply re-running `zig build migrate` does NOT fix it — 001 will keep failing against the partitioned events until the ledger is reconciled. Alternative (more invasive, not preferred): DROP tenant_default + delete the tenant_schemas row and let provisioning rebuild from scratch — destructive; only acceptable if the bench DB's tenant_default data is disposable.
root_cause_analysis.repair_dev_db_only_or_migration_fix: repair_dev_db_only — dev DB ledger reconciliation (populate tenant_default rows in public.schema_migrations + stamp migrations_applied_at) suffices; no migration-set fix and no code change needed (migration set proven correct by the test DB).
